lifecycles.pr-sync: On new commits to a reviewed PR

lifecycleHelp.commit: Runs after you commit on a branch that meets the conditions.
lifecycleHelp.prOpen: Runs once when a pull request is opened.
lifecycleHelp.prSync: Re-reviews a pull request when new commits arrive — only PRs already reviewed in that mode.

repo.title: Repository automations
repo.description: What runs automatically in this repository. Cells start from the global defaults in Settings → Automations; change one here to override it for this repository only.
repo.resetTitle: Remove all overrides and inherit the global defaults

section.title: Automations
section.description: Run an AI action automatically when something happens. These defaults apply to every repository; a repository can override them from its ⋯ menu. Reviews use the review model configured in the AI section — PR results are posted as a comment, commit results open from their notification row, and from Automation history whatever your Notify on choice for Automation results is (Settings → Notifications).
section.draftReviewsOff: Off: automated review runs when a draft is marked ready for review.

history.title: Automation history
history.description: What this repository's automations ran, what they skipped, and why.

reasons.unsettledCommit: Didn't settle — it may still be running, or the app closed mid-run
reasons.unsettledOther: Didn't settle — the app closed mid-run, or another instance owns it
reasons.needsFirstReview: waiting for a first review in this mode
reasons.claimHeld: Handed off — another review run owns this head
reasons.eligibilityError: Couldn't read review history — treated as already reviewed

history.coldStartBanner: Automations are off in cold-start test mode.
history.pausedBanner: Automations are paused while AI features are hidden.
history.noAutomationEnabled: No automation is enabled for this repository
history.newestDecisionRecorded: — the most recent decision here was recorded
history.emptyNotSetUp: No automations are set up for this repository.
history.emptyDescription: Decisions appear here as commits land and pull requests are checked.
history.wontRetry: Won't retry for this head until you push or relaunch.
